Codex r4 rejected r0 as implementation-ready; all claims independently
verified before adoption. Root cause: r0's state replay contradicted
production's contest-anchored streak (6/24 record = 13 vs local replay
15; the 6/17 anchoring design is explicit that model replay can never
raise it), 31/44 decision records persist no state, source=='mdp'
records post-clamp effective actions, and the live saver is an
operator stream (saver_state.json). r1 re-anchors state on recorded +
ledger-as-of sources only (unknown rows never diff), reframes M1 as a
one-step table-intent disagreement census (unchained, in-sample,
mechanism-only), crosses the window/provenance variants with one
primary, adds deterministic stability probes, tightens quantile/tie/
provenance/artifact contracts, splits mechanism from outcome phases,
and discloses the unblinding: the review itself computed provisional
diff counts (8/7, invalid state path) sitting at the inherited >=8
trigger — retained only as an operational threshold, with any
verdict-bearing evaluation pushed to a stream untouched tonight.
Proposes bts_daily_decision_v2 (persist state + second candidate on
every final record) as the durable production fix, separately.

r0 immutable at 4800f7a.
